headline: Weathered Expanse Seesaws Anew as Nevish Line Stirs
war_summary: The seesaw at Weathered Expanse has tipped back toward the middle since our last edition: the Wardens have clawed back two posts, and the line now reads four Colonials to three Wardens, with two bases in ruin, after fifty-nine flag actions in the past day centred on Spirit Watch and Frostmarch, the latest logged in the early evening. Northern fronts stir afresh — Nevish Line's Tomb Father was in action minutes before press time, and at Farranac Coast the flag over Transient Valley changed hands, where warden losses over the past two hours run double the colonial toll. Kuura Strand's storm goes on regardless of flags: better than nine hundred casualties a side in two hours, the posts standing three Wardens to two Colonials with one in ruin. Olavis Wake, seething through the morning, has fallen abruptly quiet since mid-afternoon. Marban Hollow still churns about Checkpoint Bua, Pari Peak has been still since early afternoon, and a fresh surge is building at Stlican Shelf near Breaker Town. Attrition climbs as well at Callahan's Passage and in the Dead Lands. This is the war's 673rd day.
